notes.title: HORROR CAM - Update V 1.5 - New Features
notes.content:
THE DESCENT UPDATE V 1.5

Happy New Year! This update offers FREE NEW CONTENT offering NEW features asked by the community + Polish to improve the experience even further. Please don't forget to review game and show your support, Thank you!

Major


 NEW HORROR CAM - New Post Process Lens FX + Dust Scratches + Wide Angle Lens + Lightbloom + GrainFX offers a horror style cam effect. Great look for spectators.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/83ed951d0f0e5cadd53edec9de0ab65e4f6135ed.jpg
NormalCam Comparison
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/690a33c02e7265192fc09bacad8de2170a194e37.jpg
Enable / Disable Only within Main Menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/7598839de5653ddfbbf87042c06447ebfdd76ecc.jpg

 NEW CAVE ATMOSPHERE - New Cave FX offering unstable cave atmosphere with random collapsing sounds + dust fx + screen shake cave tremors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/0d4a5bcc0b5f6f391c90f1953927c16a82aaa5ef.jpg

 NEW COLLECTIBLE UI STATS - Menu Level Map now displays collectible stats for each map where available in order to keep track of all your gold, miners helmets, and emma's ghost captures making it easier to collect your achievements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/ad76ff850e4171e2427cdba0839093d5afc42545.jpg

 NEW BRIGHTNESS SLIDER - New Brightness adjustment now available in settings menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/5a46de1042a018e28db50c91e7ec4fca63de1fbf.jpg


Improvements

 [NEW] Voice Acts Diaries - Modified Audio by increasing volume by 100% + Normalizing all audio volumes so there are consistent.

 [NEW] Ghosts Flash now last for 15 seconds to help player more time to take a photo.


You may need to restore your video settings...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/0d8b6995cf04f8d955a0c481a5c2b11ebb23c8a2.jpg
Or delete your settings file located in the image below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/2c7df19c73e1625e5ce32008fba6f52bfab38a1a.jpg

Again thank you for reporting suggestions and or issues! 
If you find or encounter more please report in our forum here DESCENT FORUM

notes.title: LOST MINERS UPDATE - Voice Acting Story Dialogues + New Collectibles
notes.content:
THE DESCENT UPDATE V 1.4

This update offers FREE NEW CONTENT offering NEW  VOICE ACTING STORY DIALOGUES  and NEW collectibles where player find MINERS HELMETS and SMELTED GOLD BARS scattered through out the maps to uncover 15 MORE NEW STORY ELEMENTS and acquire 2 NEW STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS.

You will need to carefully find lost miners helmets and raw gold bars scattered around the levels in order to learn more about the events that unfolded deep in the mine.

There has been limited feedback concerning bugs and or issues, and we thank you for helping us improve the game to its current version.

notes.title: Ghost Hunt Update - Capture Evidence of Ghost Presence
notes.content:
THE DESCENT UPDATE V 1.3

This update offers FREE NEW CONTENT where players can use the NEW DIGITAL CAMERA to CAPTURE GHOST ACTIVITY to uncover 15 NEW STORY ELEMENTS and acquire 3 NEW STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS.

REQUIRES YOU TO COMPLETE THE GAME OR ANY CHAPTER AND PLAY IT AGAIN TO ACTIVATE EMMA'S PRESENCE FOR YOU TO CAPTURE! 

You will need to spot various ghosts that appear scattered around the levels and capture them with Photo Camera in order to learn more about the events that unfolded deep in the mine. 

Tell us what you think of the new photo snapshot tool and perhaps offer some feedback on what would you like to see done with this new mechanic?

We have further addressed issues based on feedback and continue to polish the game for a better experience. We thank you for taking the time to report all your suggestions and any issues.
 
Please REVIEW THE GAME if you enjoy it! 

Major


 [NEW] Digital Photo Camera Equipment + Ghost Hunt Feature

notes.title: Quality of life Update v 1.1
notes.content:

This patch addresses some technical issues and a few more frustrations encountered to further polish the game. We thank you for taking the time to report all your suggestions and any issues.

Major


 Saving Graphics Settings is now fixed.

 Localized Additional Languages 
[ Added Greek, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Czech, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Dutch, Turkish ]

[Reduced confusion in some objectives by helping player focus on the problem area by controlling the area to explore.]


Minor

[Elevator Mechanical Noise Reduced / Generator Noise Reduced / etc.]

 Generator Fuse Objective Adjustment  [Updates correctly now after generator turned on.]

 Grammatical errors fixed

 Gas Chamber Coal Mine Blockade Fixed [allowed players to pass through]



Future Updates


 Currently working on Controller Support!

 Add Night Vision Battery / will Recharge when not in use! [to avoid spam using night vision]

 Fix Windows Glass Reflective Shading Issues.


Again thank you for reporting issues! 
If you find encounter more please report in our forum here DESCENT FORUM

notes.title: Quality of life Update v 1.0.10
notes.content:
THE DESCENT UPDATE V 1.0.10

This patch recognizes problems and frustrations streamers and influencers and forum members  encountered and further polishes The Descent based on that feedback. We thank you for taking the time to report all your suggestions and any issues.

Major


 Optimized game play to remove unnecessary frustrations.

 Reduced frequency of flicker lights to help ease strain on the eyes.

 Jump scare Improvements [help prevent out of focus jump scares]


Minor


 Localize missing translations including menu items.

 Added extra signs to help players navigate better.

 Modified game paths to help prevent users from getting lost.

 Added a few new objectives to help users progress.

 Background shade in text read UI is much darker to better see text.

 Reduced howling noise to help clamp highs

 Elevator Mesh + Doors modified to reduce cage improve visibility encounters.

 Elevator Button moved to center to help players see and interact with it better.

 Rockwell mine elevator now only requires to unlock one door to open both.

  General graphics improvements + polish [animations speeds / decals]


Known Issues

 Graphics settings don't save. [working on it]

 Occasional items get cleared from inventory. [this does not effect progress/ working on it]

 Log Pickup gets added to inventory. [does not effect progress / will remove in future update]


Again thank you for reporting issues! 

If you find encounter more please report in our forum here DESCENT FORUM

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.7
notes.content:

This patch further addresses various feedback provided from The Descent forum and Youtube videos. Thank you for taking the time to report all your suggestions and bugs / Issues.
